archetypes.name: dyn-summary-contract
archetypes.rationale: Checks the path-only final-summary contract across runtime, prompts, and harness pins.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed final-summary runtime and prompt contract as one surface. Verify /design emits FINAL_SUMMARY_PATH plus empty readiness markers only, and that every prompt callsite tells the orchestrator to Read the disk file instead of extracting marker bodies. Check Step 5c abort, cancellation, sidecar, and missing or empty summary paths for mismatches. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
